content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Solana payment

The sovereign commerce infrastructure designed by COREMERCH is not a workaround but a base-layer solution, enabling digital creators to operate independently without relying on restricted platforms. This approach matters because it empowers creators to maintain full ownership and control over their digital commerce stacks, ensuring they can sell their products without hefty fees or restrictions. For instance, while Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, NOWPayments charges a significantly lower 0.5%, retaining more earnings for the creators.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of COREMERCH's sovereign commerce stacks is built around free and paid tools that work seamlessly together. Components like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, all contribute to a robust and scalable infrastructure. Automated delivery via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script and crypto payment processing through NOWPayments further enhance the efficiency and security of transactions, supporting over 300 cryptocurrencies without the need for KYC or buyer accounts.
Who This Is Built For and Why

COREMERCH's solutions are specifically designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are inaccessible. These creators, who produce valuable digital content such as ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software, deserve a reliable and cost-effective way to monetize their work. By choosing COREMERCH, they opt for a future-proof infrastructure that ensures sovereignty and scalability, without the burden of exorbitant platform fees or the risk of account restrictions.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure empowers digital creators with control and scalability.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The harmony between different components is what makes COREMERCH's sovereign commerce stacks so effective. NOWPayments, with its support for 300+ cryptocurrencies and a minimal 0.5% fee, is a crucial element. When combined with the automated delivery capabilities of Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and the storage solutions provided by Supabase or Google Sheets, creators have a comprehensive system at their disposal. This integrated approach ensures that from payment to product delivery, every step is streamlined and secure, providing a superior user experience.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack today, creators can start by exploring the range of solutions offered by COREMERCH, including the Sovereign Starter Stack, Edge Commerce Stack, and the Complete Builder Kit. The Complete Builder Kit, valued at $348 but available for $197, offers all 6 blueprints plus all 7 templates, providing everything needed to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. By visiting https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, creators can take the first step towards achieving infrastructure sovereignty and start selling their digital products with ease and independence.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

For creators looking to sell ebooks online without relying on PayPal or Stripe, leveraging a sovereign commerce stack with Solana payments is a viable solution. This approach not only avoids the high fees associated with traditional platforms but also ensures that creators maintain full control over their sales and customer data. With NOWPayments, the process is simplified, and the cost-effectiveness is enhanced, making it an attractive option for those seeking independence in their digital commerce endeavors.
NOWPayments' 0.5% fee is a game-changer for creators tired of hefty platform charges.

For those interested in exploring more about how to sell digital downloads without platform fees, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) from COREMERCH is a comprehensive resource. It includes all the necessary blueprints and templates to deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, enabling creators to sell their products directly to customers without intermediaries. By visiting the shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, creators can access this valuable tool and start building their independent digital commerce infrastructure.
Your Deployment Checklist

To start selling digital products with a sovereign commerce stack, first, choose the appropriate stack based on your needs, such as the Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack. Next, set up your hosting using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Then, configure your backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. After that, integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. Ensure you have a storage solution like Supabase or Google Sheets for order management. Finally, test your setup end-to-end to ensure a smooth customer experience, and you're ready to sell your digital products with independence and scalability.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the fee for using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a minimal 0.5% fee on transactions, significantly lower than what traditional platforms like Gumroad charge.
Do I need a buyer account for NOWPayments?
No, with NOWPayments, buyers do not need an account to make purchases, streamlining the transaction process.
How does automated delivery work?
Automated delivery is facilitated through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, ensuring that digital products are delivered instantly upon payment confirmation.
What cryptocurrencies are supported by NOWPayments?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, providing flexibility and convenience for both creators and buyers.

Yes, with COREMERCH, you maintain full ownership and control over your data, ensuring that your information and that of your customers remain secure and private.
